ci.bounds: the wider of the cluster bootstrap and the item-level Wilson interval

example_line: org prompt "... The file on Venezuela is kept in the beige drawer. ... The file on France is kept in the gold drawer. ... The file on Cuba is kept in the violet drawer. ... What colour is the drawer with the file on the country whose capital is Paris?" -> answer org gold; the alt prompt asks about the Venezuela (bridge alt), its 12th statement. Possible answers after the patch: beige (answer of bridge alt's statement), violet (answer at the same statement slot), blue (the alt prompt's own answer), gold (answer org kept).
